children: Citi said on Thursday it is neutral on copper and aluminium near term at $14,000 to $15,000 per metric ton and $3,000 per ton, respectively.
The bank expects stronger supply growth for copper and aluminium in 2027, the note said.
It also highlighted upside opportunities in nickel and lead given prices are close to 2026 lows and fund positioning is relatively short.

Citi said it is constructive on tin to $60,000 per ton over the next 6-12 months given high exposure to the underlying structural and strategic medium term tailwinds for the industrial metals complex.
